observed: The real stdio tools/list smoke exposed that R05 deliverables and cost_receipt plus R16 genealogy were typed as strings although their executable contracts use array, object and array respectively.
impact: A schema-validating MCP client could reject semantically valid control inputs before evaluation.
repair: The MCP schema binding now declares deliverables=array, cost_receipt=object and genealogy=array; three regression tests were added.
preservation: The pre-fix wheel and ZIP are retained outside the canonical release tree under work/KCH_0.11_PRE_SCHEMA_FIX.
